evaluations.title: Ox and the Big Hip
evaluations.story:
The sun is a hot stamp on the sand. 
The mud is a still, green trap. 
A drip. 
*Plop.*

Pip spots a hill in the mud. 
It is not a hill. 
It is a grey stump. It is Hugo. 
Red spots on his back. 
The spots itch. The spots crawl.

evaluations.title: Splash and Stomp
evaluations.story:
Step.
Step.
Stop.

Stand on the damp sand.
The spot is still.
I see the sun in the spot.
A crisp, clear skin.

Plop.
Plop.
A drop snaps the skin.
The spot must not rest.

Stomp.
Stomp.
Chomp the spot!
Snap the skin.

evaluations.title: The Shell Switch
evaluations.story:
The sun is thin. The tide pool is a cold hush. 

This shell is much too small. His legs pinch. His back is a crush. He is a big crab in a small shack. 

Patch must dash. He is thin and soft. A gull is a black wing in the sun. He must rush to the long rock. He will dash on the path.

evaluations.title: The Shimmer and the Shell
evaluations.story:
The shack is shut.
The path is black.
Rock. Rock.
The ship on the dock.

Whish. Wash.
The mist is thick.
A thin white mist on my chin.
Click-clack.
The shell on the rock.

I walk to the sand.
My feet in the rush.
What is this?
